description: Interact with the page: click (left/right/middle, single or double), hover, type, press, scroll, or drag (press at the start point, glide to x2/y2, release). Address elements with a [ref=eN] handle from browser::snapshot (or a pick), or raw viewport coordinates.

click_count.description: Clicks in the gesture: 2 double-clicks (`click` only, default 1).

delta_y.description: Scroll distance in pixels; positive scrolls down (`scroll`).

key.description: Key name for `press`: Enter, Tab, Escape, Backspace, Delete, ArrowUp/Down/Left/Right, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown.

ref.description: Element ref from `browser::snapshot` (`e3`) or `browser::picked` (`p1`). Refs die on navigation; re-snapshot after.

x.description: Viewport x, when acting by coordinates instead of ref.

x2.description: Drag end x, in viewport pixels (`drag`). The start is `x`/`y` or a `ref`; the end is `x2`/`y2`.

y.description: Viewport y, when acting by coordinates instead of ref.

y2.description: Drag end y, in viewport pixels (`drag`).

detail.description: What was done, for the transcript.
